map.输入相邻两断面面积 A₁、A₂ 与断面间距 L，按平均断面法 V=(A₁+A₂): Enter adjacent end areas A1, A2 and spacing L; compute earthwork volume between sections by average-end-area method V=(A1+A2)/2·L, widely used for road and channel earthwork estimation.
map.输入两端断面面积 A₁、A₂ 与间距 L，求体积。: Enter end areas A1, A2 and spacing L to find volume.
map.两断面面积平均乘间距。: Average the two end areas and multiply by spacing.
map.：全线按桩号断面两两相邻算再求和，得总挖/填方。: : Along the line, compute adjacent section pairs then sum to get total cut/fill volume.
map.由半径与转角求外距: Find external distance from radius and deflection angle
map.由坡度与曲线长求竖曲线上任一点高程: Find elevation at any point on a vertical curve from grade and curve length
map.平均断面=(A₁+A₂)/2×L；棱镜体=L/6(A₁+4Am+A₂) 更准（含: Average end area = (A1+A2)/2 × L; prismoidal = L/6 (A1+4Am+A2) is more accurate (includes mid-section); both equal for linear change.
map.间距应相等或逐段用对应 L，混距直接套会错。: Spacing should be equal or use the corresponding L per segment; mixing distances in one formula is wrong.
